newsitem.title: USA: Whittman-Hart files 4.1 mln common shelf.
newsitem.headline: Whittman-Hart files 4.1 mln common shelf.

text.p: Whittman-Hart Inc said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 4,066,400 common shares.
Of the total, the company will offer 4 million shares for sale and 66,400 shares will be offered for sale by Edward V. Szofer (or his donees), The Chicago, Ill., based company said.
Whittman-Hart provides strategic information technology services designed to improve its clients' productivity and competitive position.
Szofer has been a director of the company since August 1995 and has been vice president and chief operating officer since January 1994 and secretary since May 1996.
The company said proceeds from the sale will be used in connection with acquisitions of other businesses, real or personal properties, or securities in business combination transactions.
